propositions: terraform-drift workflow does not trigger on Gerrit changes, only on pull_request, push to main, or scheduled runs, leaving terraform changes ungated before submit
Verified +1 gate provides no signal about whether committed terraform resources have been applied to infrastructure, only that code builds and tests pass
manual terraform apply step is decoupled from CI/CD and can be skipped, allowing un-applied HCL to land in main with passing checks
drift check must either run pre-submit with logic to distinguish new resources from previously-committed un-applied drift, or require explicit apply attestation before merge
the 34cd change added aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.review_interrupts to HCL that was never applied to CloudWatch, failing only after merge when terraform-drift ran post-submit
